summary: A speech synthesizer firmware in the style of the Speak & Spell: each key speaks the next word of a chosen sentence at the key's pitch. Made first for the SMK-37 keyboard; the FM-1 build maps the pads and wheels to its buttons.
features: LPC engine after the TI TMS5220; words made with espeak-ng, no TI ROM
Nine voices incl. CLASSIC, ROBOT, WHISPER and a three-voice CHOIR
Twenty sentence banks: songs, Latin chant, jokes, several languages
16 drum grooves; PLAY speaks the sentence in time
Write your own sentences on the device; USB MIDI notes and clock
FM-1 version has no key velocity; author wants FM-1 feedback
